set.body: Follow-up to native Save As and locked preference patches. Add File Open Recent submenu and pure recent-project projection, persist successful New/Open/Save As in FIFO order through patching repository, reuse existing open/recovery/dirty-work admission, and remove only definitely missing paths. Preserve the current project on failed or cancelled opens. Drain metadata writes on shutdown without waiting on FX callbacks. Test current and cold preferences, stale paths, failed opens, cancellation, order and writer ownership. S2.9 stays open until this lands.
set.title: Open Recent: native menu, ordered preferences and normal project admission
